730990101.text: Whoa! The Aranara world is truly marvelous... Just looking at a painting would lead you to the treasure...

730990102.text: Now, we've found the locations of all the paintings! Paimon wonders where the Aranara who made these treasure maps is...

730990105.text: Right, there's that painting with many Aranara in it. We didn't find any treasure there...

730990106.text: (Something seems to be vibrating slightly in the bag.)

730990108.text: Huh? Is this... the seed we found in The Chasm?

subQuests.subQuestName: Find the last place according to the vibration of the seed and the content of the picture

730990301.text: Eek! It's the Golden Nara! There is the taste of the wind, the taste of earth, and the taste of Aranara!

730990302.text: Golden Nara has figured out the Ararakalari of Arayama?

730990303.text: How dreadful! Obstructions are useless, anyone can break in, and the "happy nest" of Araminali will be "broken!"

730990304.text: Wow, don't worry, we mean no harm.

730990305.text: What does "no harm" mean? Do you mean "no greed"?

730990306.text: #Um... Paimon guesses so! {NICKNAME} and Paimon are on Aranara's side. We want to be Aranara's good friends.

730990307.text: Paimon is gluttonous, but not bad in nature.

730990308.text: Hey! That's technically not wrong, though...

730990309.text: Aranara's best friend... The Golden Nara smells like Aranara, a familiar smell, but I haven't smelled it for a long time...

730990310.text: #Ah, by the way, that strange seed! {NICKNAME}, show the seeds to Araminali. Maybe he knows something.

730990311.text: Uhh! He is thirsty! He needs to drink a lot of water before he can change back to what he was. Come... there's a lot of water here. Let him drink enough to recover.

730990312.text: You put the seed in the water...

730990314.text: #Wow! The seed has become an Aranara! We found it, "the trapped Aranara"! You see, is Paimon right, {NICKNAME}?

730990317.text: It's Aranimba! Unlike Araminali, Aranimba likes to travel around. Before, he would draw the scenery he saw from afar and send it back to Vanarana, but later...

730990318.text: Later, Aranimba went to a very hard and dark place, with little dirt, but a lot of stones... Under the soil, there was little grass and few trees, but a lot of mushrooms!

730990319.text: Um... Sounds like The Chasm. But, Aranimba, as an Aranara, traveled so far that he even left Sumeru...

730990320.text: Yes! It was a long way, and dangerous. Aranimba met the dark and dangerous Nara! However, Aranimba was protected by Aramuhukunda, and turned into a seed and "got away with it."

730990321.text: Now Aranimba is back safely, thanks to Golden Nara and White Floaty.

730990324.text: #Araminali is Aranimba's "good friend," so Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon are also Aranimba's "good friends". Aranimba gets it now!

730990325.text: Aranimba is going to leave, this time, not only painting, Aranimba will send back "gift" to Araminali, put it in the "chest."

730990326.text: All the "chests" here belong to Araminali. Araminali is the owner of the "treasure chests."

730990327.text: For good friends of Aranara who helped a lot of Aranara... Aranara will be "grateful," and will put the "treasure" into the "chest."

730990329.text: Aranara knew everything about Vana when they were born, but when "chests" were born, they were empty! Araminali doesn't know why.

730990331.text: #...When Araminali has filled the "treasure chests," Nara {NICKNAME} can open it. Sometimes Nara {NICKNAME} will cheer with "Oh yeah" and sometimes sigh with "Ah..." just as the green Nara does.

730990332.text: Why bother? Araminali and Aranimba can directly give us what you're about to put in the treasure chests as the payment.

730990333.text: #Araminali knows that the green Nara likes to go into the cave or in the house and open the "treasure chest." Nara {NICKNAME}, and Paimon, don't like it?

730990334.text: Oh... It's not like Paimon doesn't like it... It feels like... there is an inexplicable attraction?

730990335.text: Well, Nara likes "treasure chests," and so does Araminali. Araminali allows the good Nara who had helped Aranara to open the "treasure chests."

730990336.text: Vana has a lot of Aranara, some in need of help, and some want to play with Nara. Nara who realizes their wishes is Aranara's friend.

730990337.text: Such Nara can open the "treasure chests" prepared by Araminali.

730990338.text: So Aranimba should leave now, to fill the "treasure chests."

730990339.text: Hey? But didn't Aranimba just come back? Are you leaving again? You are really in a rush... like running from a fire with the headwind...

730990340.text: Eek! It's nice to have wind, but not fire. Getting too close to the fire makes Aranimba thirsty again.

730990341.text: Ah, Paimon means, how could Aranimba be in such a hurry? Aranimba could stay for a while and catch up with Araminali.

730990342.text: Araminali, you haven't seen Aranimba for a long time. Don't you have a lot to say to Aranimba?

730990343.text: Aranimba is the Aranara that will never stop so Aranimba can't be the owner of the "treasure chests."

730990344.text: Regarding the whereabouts of Aranimba, as long as Vana knows, wind knows, flowers and grass know, Araminali will know.

730990345.text: So, it's fine. Don't need to say much. Araminali will listen so long as Aranimba wants to say.

730990346.text: #Um... Is this Aranara's friendship? If it were Paimon, Paimon would have a lot to share with {NICKNAME}.

730990501.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, for bringing Aranimba back. The water in Vanarana is the best! And Aranimba is ready to go in no time.
